result.instructions: Tools for Botpress, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my Botpress bots and show which ones have runtime issues."; "How many conversations and LLM tokens did my support bot use last week?"; "Show the last 20 conversations of my bot with their messages.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Botpress data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run botpress_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run botpress_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run botpress_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. botpress_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: botpress_get_bot
tools.title: Get bot
tools.description: Get one bot: name, type, deploy time, tags and the enabled state of its integrations. The signing secret and integration configuration are left out on purpose. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/bots/{id}.

tools.name: botpress_get_bot_logs
tools.title: Get bot logs
tools.description: Read bot logs with level, user, conversation and message filters. Use real ISO 8601 timestamps with a timezone; times are normalized to UTC and timeStart must not be later than timeEnd. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/bots/{id}/logs.

timeStart.description: Start of the time range, ISO 8601 with a timezone (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

timeEnd.description: End of the time range, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

messageContains.description: Keep logs whose message contains this text.

nextToken.description: Pagination cursor: the top-level nextToken value from the previous response.

tools.name: botpress_list_bot_issues

tools.name: botpress_get_bot_content
tools.title: Inspect Studio bot content
tools.description: Inspect authenticated Studio bot JSON in bounded pages. Returns a snapshot_hash and observed JSON Pointer paths; follow paths to inspect workflow/instruction strings. Credential fields are omitted. Does not change or publish anything. API: official SDK getBotJson.

path.description: JSON Pointer from get_bot_content, e.g. /workflows/0/nodes/1/instructions. Use observed paths; never guess a Studio schema.

tools.name: botpress_preview_bot_content_edit
tools.title: Validate and preview Studio text edits
tools.description: Read-only local preview/validation of existing workflow or instruction text replacements against a fresh snapshot_hash. Returns before/after changes and preview_hash for user approval. No draft save, vendor compile validation or publish occurs. Only observed string paths may be edited; structure/IDs/settings/credentials cannot be changed.

path.description: JSON Pointer from get_bot_content, e.g. /workflows/0/nodes/1/instructions. Use observed paths; never guess a Studio schema.

value.description: Replacement text for one existing workflow/instruction string. No new keys, node IDs, transitions, credentials or metadata changes.

tools.name: botpress_publish_bot_content_edit
tools.title: Publish approved Studio text edits
tools.description: WRITE: publish exactly the approved text edits to the live Studio bot using official SDK publishFromBotJson. Obtain user approval first. Requires confirm:true, snapshot_hash, exact preview_hash and stable operation_id. Rechecks current content, preserves all unedited data and prevents replay after uncertain publication. No atomic vendor conditional write: avoid simultaneous Studio edits. Hosted persistent operation storage is required. Inspect status/Studio before retrying; success requires readback of text and a changed deployment timestamp.

path.description: JSON Pointer from get_bot_content, e.g. /workflows/0/nodes/1/instructions. Use observed paths; never guess a Studio schema.

value.description: Replacement text for one existing workflow/instruction string. No new keys, node IDs, transitions, credentials or metadata changes.

operation_id.description: Unique stable ID for this approved publish. Reuse it to inspect/retry; never change it after an uncertain result.

tools.name: botpress_get_content_operation
tools.title: Inspect content publish operation
tools.description: Read the persistent result of a content publish in this authenticated workspace and bot. An uncertain outcome must be reconciled in Studio; never retry it with a new operation_id.

operation_id.description: Unique stable ID for this approved publish. Reuse it to inspect/retry; never change it after an uncertain result.
